title: byte values are not valid map keys
purpose: A byte key is rejected rather than stored.

failure.justification: The key category may be rejected statically or when the literal is evaluated.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-007): byte values are not map keys (as the book and fake-storage rules already state); spec 6.3 must drop byte from the key list.
